title: Update Asset Request
description: Multipart form for editing an asset. Only the fields sent change. A new file replaces the bytes under the same uuid, so every page using the asset shows the new file.

name.description: New label (empty keeps the current one)

group_ids.description: Comma-separated ids of the groups that may view the asset; replaces the current set (empty = public)

role_ids.description: Comma-separated ids of the roles that may manage the asset in the CMS; replaces the current set
